content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: runtime-service-prod - container crashloop on node gpu-17 in gpu-pool-3. Crash type: SIGSEGV. Past 6m: 48 restarts. Alerting on high restart rate and 5xx spike to customers.

oncall-sre: Acknowledging. Looking.

matt: Replied to pager, diving in. Which model/variant is spiking?

anya: From logs it looks like requests hitting tnt-quant model (tnt-1-4bit) on that pool. We saw increased tail latency before restarts.

runtime-eng: :eyes: Likely fused-kernel path for KV cache/attention. We rolled an experimental kernel last week to improve perf for 4-bit. Could be related.

infra-eng: Node info: GPU type A100-sxm, driver 525. We'll cordon node gpu-17 to avoid routing new traffic. Command: `kubectl cordon gpu-17` executed.

oncall-sre: Cordoned. Scaling rules triggered fallback to warm standby in other pools. Customers still see elevated 5xx (~7% on that region).

support-alex: Which customers hit? I'm compiling list for CS. Initial: orgs alpha-co, beta-app, gamma-saas — all using tnt-1-4bit.

matt: Dumped recent container logs. Here's the end of one crash trace:

```
[2029-06-12T03:47:11Z] runtime_engine: segfault at 0x7ffde3f0 ip 0x7f9b8c2a4b10 sp 0x7ffde3e8 error 6
#0  0x7f9b8c2a4b10 in fused_attention_kv_get+0x40
#1  0x7f9b8c2a9c2 in run_attention_layer+0x1f2
#2  0x7f9b8c307d4 in execute_forward_pass+0x185
#3  0x7f9b8c4d5b9 in request_worker_main+0x4c9
```

matt: The ip resolves to our custom fused_attention kernel.

runtime-eng: Confirmed. That symbol matches the experimental kernel we shipped to reduce mem-copy for 4-bit attention. Reverting that patch might stop the segfault.

anya: OOMs? The node GPU mem was at ~92% before crash, but CUDA OOMs are not in logs. It's a SIGSEGV, not OOM. Could be pointer use-after-free in KV cache path under high concurrency.

ops-liz: We can scale out to relieve concurrency pressure. Increasing replicas for runtime-service-prod in pool-2 and pool-4 now. `kubectl scale deployment/runtime-service-prod --replicas=30 -n prod`

infra-eng: Replica scale started. New pods in pool-2 are healthy. Rolling traffic off gpu-17 continues.

oncall-sre: For immediate mitigation we should disable the experimental kernel via runtime flags in config: set `USE_FUSED_ATTENTION=false` in the runtime config map and trigger a rolling restart of runtime pods. That should fallback to safe attention path.

runtime-eng: Agreed. I'm pushing a safe revert toggle to config now. Patch: `k8s: update cm runtime-config: USE_FUSED_ATTENTION=false` Then `kubectl rollout restart deployment/runtime-service-prod`.

matt: Patching config and restarting. Command: `kubectl patch cm runtime-config -n prod --type merge -p '{"data":{"USE_FUSED_ATTENTION":"false"}}'` then restart.

incident-bot: Deploy-bot: rollout restart started for deployment/runtime-service-prod (batch 1/5).

support-alex: Notifying affected customers: short note prepared to send via CS with ETA.

pm-jordan: Flagging potential customer impact on pricing SLOs; will brief leadership after initial mitigation.

runtime-eng: While rollout is in progress, there are still pods on gpu-17 crashing from old binary. We should drain gpu-17 now to evict old pods: `kubectl drain gpu-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`.

infra-eng: Draining gpu-17. Warning: some pods will be terminated and rescheduled.

matt: After draining, crash rate dropped to 3 restarts in 10m and 5xx rate fell to 1.2%. Rolling restarts continue.

anya: Logs from a restarted pod (post-toggle) show no segfaults in last 6m and attention code using fallback path. Sample log: `attention: using safe_attention_fp16 path`.

runtime-eng: Great. We'll keep the toggle off and roll a formal revert of the kernel. Also kicking off a postmortem runbook item to add better memory-safety checks in fused kernel and sanitizers for the fused build.

oncall-sre: Current status: node gpu-17 cordoned + drained, rollout to disable fused kernel 100% complete, crashloop rate back to baseline, customer 5xx spike mitigated. Keeping the incident open for root cause investigation.

support-alex: Sent customer update: "We detected a runtime crash affecting some requests with tnt-1-4bit. We routed traffic away from the impacted node and disabled an experimental kernel. Requests should be stable; follow-ups will include a root cause and timeline for a safe kernel re-release."

pm-jordan: Noted. Will prepare executive summary once we close RCA.

runtime-eng: Next steps: roll formal rollback of kernel commit, add CI unit that fuzz-tests fused_attention under concurrency, add metrics for segfault counter from runtime to alert earlier.

ops-liz: Filing infra task to add node-level isolations for experimental kernels so we can pilot without global exposure.

matt: Closing the urgent pager. Leaving oncall monitoring for 2h.

oncall-sre: Acknowledged. If anything flares, re-open thread. :thumbsup:
